A token of your victory over the forces of the Endless Night. You may earn Signets of the Endless Night by defeating the Spectral Dragon in Delera's Graveyard while the [[Mabar Endless Night Festival]] is active. You may earn one Signet of the Endless Night per day.

Each character can acquire a Signet of the Endless Night the first time per day they defeat the Spectral Dragon - further runs in a day will award Spectral Dragon Scales like normal but not Signets. The "day" for signets resets at midnight UTC / 8PM US eastern time, the same as daily challenge tokens ({{Forums|p=5148210}}).
